title: TenancyLocationPausedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.location.paused` version 1: a location stopped taking orders until a moment, with a reason; it takes orders again at `until` by itself. Never the message customers read. The envelope's `partner_id` is the location's partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner of the location, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.
